questions.question: Born on this day in 1983, which Texas-born American country music artist released her debut self-titled album independently in 2001?
questions.explanation: Born in Longview, Texas, country singer-songwriter Miranda Lambert launched her recording career with a self-released album in 2001.
questions.context:
On this day in 1983: Miranda Lambert, American singer-songwriter and guitarist
Miranda Lambert (American country singer (born 1983)): Miranda Leigh Lambert McLoughlin (née Lambert; formerly Shelton; born November 10, 1983) is an American country music singer–songwriter. Born in Longview, Texas, she started out in early 2001 when she released her self-titled debut album independently.

questions.question: Which Japanese filmmaker directed, wrote, and created the visual effects for the 2023 monster film Godzilla Minus One?
questions.explanation: Takashi Yamazaki spearheaded the 2023 release, taking charge of its writing, direction, and visual effects.
questions.context: Godzilla Minus One (2023 film by Takashi Yamazaki): Godzilla Minus One  is a 2023 Japanese epic kaiju film written, directed, and with visual effects by Takashi Yamazaki. It is the 37th film in the Godzilla franchise, the 33rd film thereof produced by Toho, and the fifth installment in the Reiwa era. Set in postwar Japan, the film stars Ryunosuke Kamiki as a former kamikaze pilot suffering from post-traumatic stress disorder after encountering the giant monster Godzilla.

questions.question: Which technology firm, based in Santa Clara, California, is famous for developing graphics processing units and AI hardware?
questions.explanation: Headquartered in Santa Clara, Nvidia is a major technology company known for designing GPUs and artificial intelligence systems.
questions.context: Nvidia (American multinational technology company): Nvidia Corporation is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. The company develops graphics processing units (GPUs), systems on chips (SoCs), and application programming interfaces (APIs) for data science, high-performance computing, artificial intelligence (AI) hardware, and mobile and automotive applications.

questions.question: Keira Knightley stars alongside Ben Whishaw and Sarah Lancashire in which British spy action thriller series produced for Netflix?
questions.explanation: Created by Joe Barton, Black Doves features Keira Knightley in a high-stakes story centred around a secret organisation of spies for hire.
questions.context: Black Doves (British spy action television series (2024–present)): Black Doves is a British spy action thriller television series created by Joe Barton. The series, starring Keira Knightley, Ben Whishaw, and Sarah Lancashire, is developed by Sister and Barton's production company Noisy Bear for Netflix. The series is about a spies-for-hire organisation that obtains secrets for the highest bidder. Ahead of its premiere on 5 December 2024, it was renewed for a second series which was released in full on 5 November 2026.

questions.question: Before being drafted by the Chicago Bears, quarterback Caleb Williams won the 2022 Heisman Trophy while playing college football for which university?
questions.explanation: Williams earned the 2022 Heisman Trophy as a player for the USC Trojans before moving on to the NFL.
questions.context: Caleb Williams (American football player (born 2001)): Caleb Williams is an American professional football quarterback for the Chicago Bears of the National Football League (NFL). Following one season of college football with the Oklahoma Sooners, he played for the USC Trojans, winning the Heisman Trophy in 2022 and setting single season school records in passing yards and touchdowns.
